About the bakery

The bakery opened in a small shop on a quiet street. Two bakers start work at four in the morning so the first loaves are ready when the doors open. The shop also sells rolls, buns and a few cakes at the weekend. Everything on this page is in the server HTML; the only script writes the current year.

Visit

The shop is open from seven in the morning until two in the afternoon, Monday to Saturday. Bring your own bag if you can. We take cards and cash.
